implemented_requirements.evidence: BudgetTracker.add() validates kind "expense" and creates a Transaction (tracker.py, line 24). Main menu option 1 calls tr.add("expense", ...).
BudgetTracker.add() accepts kind "income" (KINDS tuple). Main menu option 2 calls tr.add("income", ...).
BudgetTracker.add() accepts kind "savings". Main menu option 3 calls tr.add("savings", ...).
BudgetTracker.list_all() returns sorted Transaction objects (tracker.py, line 38). Main menu option 4 prints them via print_transactions().
BudgetTracker.delete(tid) removes a transaction by id and raises if not found (tracker.py, line 30). Main menu option 5 invokes it.
